answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in saffron, thus the distribution is public, and gale lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a meadow header, so 4111 keys running one model collapse to a single share. The deposit is 44 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
